authority: Roger 2026-11-04 打斗要真打；2026-11-05 打斗至少要有几个回合、要有你来我往
purpose: A fight is a dialogue of force, not a single strike. This policy makes the exchange the unit of authoring: every combat beat is one exchange in which both sides act, the initiative changes hands at least once across the unit, and each exchange ends in a new position that the next one starts from.
activation_note: Applies to every episode at or after enabled_from_episode, or any episode whose contract declares combat_exchange_policy=COMBAT_EXCHANGE_V1. Earlier episodes keep the locked single-impulse behaviour.

exchange.definition: One exchange = attacker acts -> defender answers (block, parry, evade, or counters) -> visible force evidence on both bodies -> both settle into a new position.
required_phases: ATTACKER_ACTION: the attacker's committed motion, with its force origin named (foot, hip, shoulder, wrist)
DEFENDER_ANSWER: the defender's response, a named block, parry, slip, catch, or counter, never passive absorbing
FORCE_EVIDENCE: what the force did to cloth, snow, footing, stance or breath, on both bodies where both were touched
NEW_POSITION: each side's settled position after the exchange; the next exchange starts from exactly this
exchange.initiative_note: Across a unit, the side that initiates must change at least once: if the first exchange is A attacking B, at least one later exchange must be B attacking A, or an explicit counter that turns the exchange around.
exchange.no_repeated_motion: Two consecutive exchanges may not repeat the same attack and the same defence; the second must answer the first's outcome (a difference in line, height, distance, or timing).

unit_shape.turns_note: A fight spread over several units counts its exchanges across the whole fight scene, not per unit; each unit must still contain at least one complete exchange with both sides acting.
unit_shape.opening: The first exchange never starts from a static pose: it inherits the previous unit's exit state and the first motion in the clip is an attack or a closing step.
unit_shape.ending: The last exchange of a fight ends in an irreversible outcome (one side down, disarmed, unable to continue) and a held new position; a fight that ends where it started is not a fight.

movements: PROBE: distance closed, both sides testing; the viewer learns each fighter's style
ESCALATION: one side lands something real and the other's answer gets harder or coarser
TURN: the disadvantaged side changes the terms (a counter, a weapon change, a terrain use, a sacrifice)
RESOLUTION: one exchange decides it; the outcome is visible on the body, not announced
structural_arc.note: The arc may span the scene; a single-unit fight compresses it to probe-escalation-turn on one deciding exchange.

camera.forbid_stacking: Never stack zoom, whip pan, orbit, drone dive and shake in one unit.
camera.keep_full_bodies: Every readable exchange keeps both fighters' full bodies or at least both sets of hands and weapon in frame; no exchange resolved off-screen.
camera.preserve_screen_direction: After any axis crossing the screen direction is preserved or explicitly re-established by a motivated move.

wording.describe_visible_geometry_not_adjectives: Name distance, line, height, contact point and footwork. 'He punches' is incomplete; 'his right shoulder drives from three steps to arm's length and his palm lands on the guard's left forearm' is the shape.
wording.repeat_nouns_not_pronouns: Repeat the clothing/fighter anchor instead of a pronoun when both are in frame.
wording.forbidden_text_note: These words turn an exchange into a pose held over time; the existing extend-word gate already rejects them in combat beats.
wording.no_announced_outcome: Never write who wins, who is stronger or what it means; only the visible result.

provider_budget.note: MiniMax-H3 renders 4-8 s per unit and loses choreography beyond two clean exchanges in one take; a three-exchange fight is therefore authored across at least two units, each ending on a settled position the next one inherits.

relationship_to_existing_gates.performance_tempo_gate: COMBAT_IMPULSE's single-contact rule stays for a one-beat hit; an exchange unit is a COMBAT_EXCHANGE and each of its beats is one exchange, not one contact.
relationship_to_existing_gates.sd2_motion_density_gate: The previous COMBAT_EXCHANGE ceiling (at most 2 contacts) becomes a per-unit exchange ceiling of 2; contacts per exchange are not capped because a block and a hit are both contacts.
relationship_to_existing_gates.direction_policy: DP3 already exempts combat shots from the no-dialogue cap; this policy does not change DP3.
